Meals.note: Sum of Meals lines for one employee on one date, divided by attendees_count

max_age_rule: submitted_at date minus expense_date must be 60 days or less

approval.rule: Approver must be in the submitter's management chain with approval_limit_cents at least the claim total in USD. Nobody approves their own claim.
approval.top_of_chain: VP claims are approved by the Chief Financial Officer; the CFO's claims by the VP of Operations.

foreign_currency: Claims in EUR, GBP or CAD carry fx_rate = USD per 1 unit of claim currency. USD value = amount_cents x fx_rate, rounded half up to the cent, per line. All lines on a claim must be in the claim currency.
payment: Approved claims are paid in the weekly Thursday payout run at least 2 days after approval.
